meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 Codex 作为命令行智能体，与 Claude 并用或替代，支持工具调用与历史续接。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你 用的工具支持多智能体（如 OneCLI），想换成或搭配 OpenAI 的代码模型。
copy.tagline_en: Configure Codex as your coding agent, with tool use and session history.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use OneCLI and want to replace or pair Claude with OpenAI Codex.

howto.what: 装上后，你的 agent 可以改用 OpenAI 的 Codex 作为后台引擎，负责规划、调用工具和使用 MCP 工具，也能与 Claude 并用或替代。每个分组可单独切换，记忆会自动延续。
howto.when: 当你想让某个 agent 分组改用 Codex 而不是 Claude，或需要安装 Codex 支持时。

say.text: 帮我安装 Codex 作为 agent provider。
say.note: 会执行安装和认证流程。

say.text: 把分组 A 的 provider 切换到 codex。
say.note: A 组将改用 Codex 运行。
需要先确认，会修改默认设置。

howto.what_en: After install, your agent can use OpenAI's Codex as its backend for planning, tool calls, and MCP tools, alongside or instead of Claude. Each group switches independently; memory carries over automatically.
howto.when_en: When you want a group to use Codex instead of Claude, or need to install Codex support.

say_en.text: Help me install Codex as an agent provider.
say_en.note: Runs the install and auth flow.

say_en.text: Switch group A's provider to codex.
say_en.note: Group A will run on Codex.

say_en.text: Make new groups default to Codex.
